explication: Jet combines schema-driven Go code generation with a type-safe SQL construction and query-result mapping library. The generator connects to a supported database, retrieves schema metadata, and emits SQL-builder and model types; application code then uses those types with Jet’s dialect APIs to build and execute queries and map results into Go destinations. The graph preserves the three dialect families and the statement-cache capability visible in the tree. Several internal links are omitted where the excerpts or documented relationships do not establish the caller or call direction.
